hero.title: Christening Packages
hero.lede: After the service, bring everyone back to us. We lay a private room for the family, serve a lunch or a buffet from our own kitchen, and have rooms in the hotel for relatives who have travelled for the day.

sections.title: A christening party at Bentley Hotel
sections.html:
A christening, or a naming day, is one of the few occasions that brings every generation of a family into one room: the baby and the parents, the grandparents, godparents and cousins, and friends who have known the family for years. The service or ceremony is usually in the morning or around midday, and afterwards everyone wants to sit down, eat and pass the baby round.

At Bentley Hotel that part is ours to look after. For a smaller family party we lay the conservatory beside the restaurant; for a larger one, our Back o’ Barns function suite seats up to 100 and is air-conditioned. You choose between a sit-down lunch and a buffet, both cooked in our own kitchen, and we agree the menu with you beforehand. Tell us about allergies, children’s portions and anyone who’d rather have something plain, and we’ll plan around them. Bring the cake and we’ll give it a stand, a knife and a moment of its own.

We’re easy to reach from wherever the service is held: junction 6 of the M74 is close by, parking at the hotel is free, and for anyone coming by train Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk. For relatives coming from further afield, the hotel has 18 en-suite rooms, including a family room with a double and a single bed, so grandparents or a young family can stay the night before and the night after.

sections.title: The room, the lunch and the night after

items.title: A room of your own
items.text: The conservatory for a smaller family party, or the Back o' Barns function suite, air-conditioned and seating up to 100. Either way we set the room aside for you for the afternoon.

items.title: A lunch or a buffet
items.text: Choose a sit-down lunch or a buffet, both cooked in our own kitchen. We agree the menu with you beforehand and cater for children, allergies and plain eaters. This season's menus are confirmed when you enquire.

items.title: Rooms for the family
items.text: Grandparents and relatives travelling for the day can stay the night with us. Double and twin rooms and a family room with a double and a single bed, all en suite, with a full Scottish breakfast cooked to order when it is part of the rate.

sections.title: Christening parties: what people ask us

items.q: How far ahead should we book?
items.a: As soon as you have the date of the service. Weekend dates tend to go first, so the earlier you call us on 01698 265588 or send an enquiry, the more choice you’ll have. We’ll confirm the room, the menu and this season’s prices and hold the date.

items.q: How many people can you take?
items.a: The conservatory suits smaller family parties, and the function suite seats up to 100 for a meal or takes up to 120 for a standing reception. Tell us a rough number when you enquire and a firm one nearer the day.

items.q: Can you cater for children and for dietary requirements?
items.a: Yes. Tell us how many children are coming and their ages, along with any allergies, intolerances and vegetarian or vegan guests, and we’ll build the menu around everyone.

items.q: Can we bring our own cake?
items.a: Yes. Bring it on the day, or drop it off beforehand by arrangement, and we’ll set it out with a stand and a knife ready for the cutting.

sections.title: Plan the christening party
sections.text: Tell us the date, your numbers and whether you’d like a lunch or a buffet, and we’ll take it from there.
